Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Philadelphia for 2026, and here is what he found: 32 family events, at least 12 of them free. The new additions are the Chestnut Hill Community Holiday Parade (December 5) and the Ardmore Holiday Tree Lighting with Free Santa Photos (November 27), joining the Christmas Village, Franklin Square, LumiNature and the Holiday Garden Railway. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Philadelphia

  • 32 Christmas events for kids in Philadelphia
  • At least 12 free events, including the Chestnut Hill Community Holiday Parade and the Ardmore Holiday Tree Lighting with Free Santa Photos
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Chestnut Hill Community Holiday Parade (December 5, 9 am) and the Ardmore tree lighting (November 27)
  • Season: the live cards plus November 27 and December 5 additions

Planning a day beyond the city? Philadelphia families also use our guides to Christmas events in West Chester, Wayne and Wilmington for trains, lights and Santa visits.
